descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de inginerie
Company Overview: 
 At EPCM 10 , we apply our experience to delivering project management services tailored to our Clients’ needs. Our Client-focused approach creates close links between Clients, suppliers, contractors, designers, consultants and authorities. We address day-to-day technical and coordination challenges, focusing on completion in line with project schedule, quality and budget objectives. For these positions, we act as the Client’s representative on renewable energy projects.
 Role Summary: 
 We are seeking a QA&QC Engineer to join EPCM 10 ’s site-based supervision team on renewable energy projects in Onesti, Bacau County . The role represents the Client’s interests in assessing the quality of the works and reviewing the effectiveness of Contractors’ quality processes. The successful candidate will work with civil and electrical engineers, designers, contractors and other stakeholders, maintaining reliable evidence of compliance and tracking outstanding items through to handover. This role does not replace the Contractor’s QA/QC team or its own quality control. The projects are located in Romania and are subject to Romanian legislation, technical regulations and standards applicable in the country, as well as applicable European requirements.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Project Quality Planning and Control 
Review the Building Permit, conditions of applicable approval and endorsements, the Technical and Detail Design and contract specifications with the Project Manager and site specialists, identifying quality and documentation requirements for each work front.
Develop and maintain the Client’s inspection, test and quality deliverables matrix; cross-check the Contractor’s inspection and test plans (ITPs) against the project control programme, including faze determinante and inspection points before concealed works are covered.
Confirm with the project lead that the appointed diriginți de șantier cover the relevant disciplines; coordinate their participation, together with the Designer and other stakeholders, in the applicable checks without replacing their statutory responsibilities.
Review works procedures, sampling, testing frequency, proposed laboratories and acceptance criteria; record comments and refer them to the Contractor and responsible specialists.
 Materials and Workmanship Inspection 
Check, on a sampling basis and in accordance with the ITPs, that materials and equipment match accepted submittals; collect declarations of performance or conformity, certificates, batch identification and suitability documentation where applicable.
Inspect storage and preservation arrangements and monitor excavations, foundations, reinforcement, concrete pours, piles, trenches, cables and electrical equipment with the discipline engineers, according to the assigned scope and the individual’s competence.
Review inspection requests, availability of results and work-front readiness; witness tests and check concealed-work records before covering.
Compare soil, compaction, concrete, electrical testing and other reports against design criteria and refer out-of-limit results to the responsible technical personnel.
 Non-Conformities, Interfaces and Reporting 
Record non-conformities with references to location, the requirement not met, drawing, photograph and impact; inform the Project Manager, discipline engineer and relevant diriginte de șantier.
Track root-cause analysis, the Contractor’s proposed corrective action and the Designer’s solution where required; verify implementation evidence and recommend closure in accordance with the project procedure.
Immediately flag any deviation that could affect safety or quality and request that the affected activity does not proceed until assessed by the competent responsible parties; respect the statutory stop-work powers of appointed specialists.
Prepare periodic reports in English for the Client covering inspections, tests, missing documentation, non-conformities, overdue actions and risks to construction milestones.
 Acceptance and Documentation 
Verify traceability between activities, inspection records, tests, materials, non-conformities and as-built drawings submitted by the Contractor.
Support the diriginte de șantier and project team in compiling documentation for the cartea tehnică a construcției, without assuming the statutory role reserved for the appointed specialist.
Prepare punch lists by system or area and verify evidence of rectification; support acceptance inspections and the commissioning team without replacing the acceptance committee or those responsible for energisation.
 Candidate Requirements: 
Degree in Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a discipline relevant to the assigned works.
Experience in QA/QC and construction supervision in Romania; experience on wind, photovoltaic or BESS projects is an advantage.
Experience reviewing ITPs, inspection requests, tests, material traceability, non-conformities, concealed-work records and handover documentation.
Practical familiarity with the Romanian quality-control system, faze determinante, cartea tehnică a construcției and the roles of the diriginte de șantier, Designer and RTE.
Ability to interpret drawings and acceptance criteria within the individual’s discipline and consult the responsible engineers for other disciplines.
Written and spoken English is mandatory and is the primary working language. All EPCM 10 communication with Clients and project stakeholders, including meetings, reports, correspondence and minutes, shall be in English. Ability to interpret Romanian technical and regulatory documentation and explain its requirements and implications in English. Documents required by Romanian authorities shall retain the legally applicable language and format
Strong organisational skills, rigorous document control, MS Office proficiency and availability to join a site-based team.
This is an engineering and Client-representation role, not an appointment as diriginte de șantier. Authorisation as diriginte de șantier is neither required nor a preferred selection criterion for this position. The role does not include acts or signatures legally reserved for the professionals appointed to those responsibilities.
 Important Note 
 This is a site-based role within EPCM 10 ’s supervision team in Bacau County, Romania. Allocation between projects and sites will be determined according to requirements. This is not a remote-working position.
 The role is performed within EPCM 10 ’s contractual scope and delegated authority. The Contractor retains responsibility for execution, resources, construction methods, the safety of its works and its own quality control; the Designer retains authorship of and responsibility for design solutions and calculations.
 EPCM 10 ’s reviews, monitoring or recommendations do not transfer these responsibilities. Formal approvals, contractual instructions, changes to cost or schedule and acceptance of the works are subject to the project authority matrix. This position does not include the statutory role of diriginte de șantier or acts or signatures legally reserved for designers, Designer verifiers or other authorised and appointed professionals.
